authors: Kakusaburo Onda, Eizo Sada, Takeshi Kobayashi, Shigeharu Kito, Kunimitsu Ito (author list not re-verified from page; first page of the paper begins on PDF page 2)
journal: Journal of Chemical Engineering of Japan 3(2), 137-142
title: Solubility of gases in aqueous solutions of mixed salts
experimental_method: Gas volumetric method (same apparatus as Onda et al. 1970, JCEJ 3, 18): measured gas volume contacted with degassed mixed-salt solution at 25 C and 1 atm; solubility expressed as Bunsen absorption coefficient.
uncertainties_stated: Pure-water check: acetylene Bunsen coefficient 0.9487, three runs, range 0.14%. Text notes the KHCO3/NaHCO3 mixtures (approximately constant ionic strength fractions, some CO3(2-) coexisting with HCO3(-)) may be less accurate. No uncertainties for table rows.
quality_remarks: Concentration of each solution verified by density (calibrated curve), evaporation, or titration. Gas purity CO2 99.8%, C2H4 99.6%, C2H2 99.6%. Salt content given as total ionic strength I [mol/l] and ionic strength fraction xi of the first salt; per-salt molarity not tabulated. Table 3 NaCl row I=2.213 alpha=0.0065 is physically implausible (single-salt NaCl at I=1.302 gives 0.6942; likely misprint e.g. 0.6065 but kept as printed, confirmed on the 200 dpi image). Table 2 Na2SO4+NH4NO3: alpha 0.0926 at I=0.904 and 0.0964 at I=0.915 (non-monotonic, as printed). Table 2 HNO3 alpha is nearly independent of I (0.1114, 0.1113, 0.1103, 0.1096, 0.1105). Table 1 BaCl2+NH4NO3 has near-duplicate points I=0.331/0.335 (alpha 0.7370/0.7371). The text-layer of the PDF truncates some cells (e.g. Table 1 CaCl2+NH4NO3 '3.351 0.56' is 0.5638 on the image).
